observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor sandy area in front of a stage with red and white decorations, banners, and an audience seated under a canopy
observation.dancers: mixed group of women and men
observation.formation_and_space: dancers enter from the side, spreading out across the sandy performance area in shifting group formations and individual pairings
observation.posture: upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight centered on balls of feet with light stepping
observation.footwork: quick light steps and shifting weight on the beat, moving forward and turning; exact foot placement occluded by traditional skirts and low frame rate
observation.arms_and_hands: women hold black and white feathery fans extending outwards and fluttering; men hold wooden shields and swords, moving arms defensively and offensively
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains mostly upright with slight turns and shifts; hips remain relatively still
observation.partnering: individual interplay between men and women simulating confrontation and courtship without body contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent quick turns, low crouching on knees, sudden drops to one knee with shields
observation.costume_and_props: traditional Dayak attire including ornate patterned skirts, beaded vests, elaborate headdresses with feathers, face/body painting; props include feathery hand fans for women, wooden shields and swords for men
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and precise weight distribution are obscured by costume length and video sampling rate
